content: The dataset also presents many opportunities for further study. For instance, we collected annotator-provided explanations for each example that the model got wrong. We provided inference labels for the development set, opening up possibilities for interesting more fine-grained studies of NLI model performance. While we verified the development and test examples, we did not verify the correctness of each training example, which means there is probably some room for improvement there.
